mechanics.claim: Falling Star deals its damage on impact, after a 1.25 second delay from cast, not instantly on cast.
mechanics.quote: calls down a star that strikes the target location after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The Skies Descend impact damage is a separate, higher damage instance than base Falling Star, dealing 25% increased damage in a larger area.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{ccs|25% increased damage|magic}} in a larger area

mechanics.claim: The Skies Descend additionally sends a shockwave that deals a separate magic damage instance to enemy champions and epic monsters (not other minions), after the initial impact.
mechanics.quote: the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing {{ccs|{{as|magic damage}}|magic}} to enemy champions and epic {{tip|monsters}} hit

mechanics.claim: Enemies directly hit by the star's impact do not also take the shockwave's damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.

mechanics.claim: Falling Star transforms into the empowered The Skies Descend once 75 Stardust has been gathered since the last empowered cast (or since learning the ability).
mechanics.quote: Aurelion Sol will transform ''Falling Star'' into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'' each time he gathers {{as|75 Stardust}} from the last time he used the empowered cast, or once he has gathered that amount after learning the ability.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
Falling Star has no cast time (only a queue time and the travel delay before impact).
